nodes.title: SG-7.4 · Write a structured execution report after each worker run
nodes.body:
Context: backend/worker/internal/runner.Runner.Run persists only a store.Execution record under .storyforge/executions and writes no report. Desired behavior: after every run that took the lock, a JSON report is written to development/executions/<id>.json. Success, failure and awaiting-approval all produce one. The ID is validated by the same rule as store.Store. Expected result: reviewable, committed execution summaries. Why: the product requires persisted structured execution reports.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a run that fails, succeeds or awaits approval, When Run returns, Then <ReportDir>/<id>.json exists with the final status
- Given an execution ID such as ../evil, When a report is written, Then it is rejected with store.ErrInvalidID and no file is created outside ReportDir


## Scope
- In scope: Export of the store ID validator
- In scope: New report writer package
- In scope: Runner integration
- Out of scope: Git commit of reports
- Out of scope: Admin UI changes
- Out of scope: Worker config file fields
- Preserve: store.Store behavior and JSON format
- Preserve: Runner.New signature
- Preserve: Existing runner tests


## Technical constraints
- Go 1.22, module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/worker
- No database; plain JSON files written atomically
- Same ID rule as store.idPattern


## Definition of done
- All three requirements implemented and verified by unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- Atomic writes via temp file and rename


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · The store's execution ID validation is reusable by other packages
nodes.body:
Context: store.validateID is unexported, so another package cannot apply the same rule. Desired behavior: an exported store.ValidateID with identical behavior, used by Save and Get. Expected result: one source of truth for ID safety. Why: the intent requires validating the ID the same way the state store does.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given "../evil" or an empty string, When store.ValidateID is called, Then it returns an error wrapping ErrInvalidID
- Given "exec-1.2", When store.ValidateID is called, Then it returns nil


## Scope
- In scope: Rename validateID to ValidateID in store.go
- Out of scope: Changing the ID pattern
- Preserve: ErrInvalidID semantics
- Preserve: Save and Get rejecting bad ids


## Technical constraints
- Behavior must be unchanged


## Definition of done
- ValidateID exported and used by Save and Get


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A report writer persists validated, atomically written JSON reports
nodes.body:
Context: no report package exists. Desired behavior: report.Writer{dir}.Write(Report) validates ID with store.ValidateID, creates the directory, and atomically writes indented JSON containing execution id, round id, status, attempts, error, started_at, finished_at and duration_ms. Expected result: a structured file per execution. Why: persisted execution summaries.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a valid Report, When Write is called, Then <dir>/<id>.json decodes to the same field values
- Given an invalid ID, When Write is called, Then it returns an error wrapping store.ErrInvalidID and the directory has no files


## Scope
- In scope: backend/worker/internal/report/report.go
- Out of scope: Runner wiring
- Preserve: store package API


## Technical constraints
- Atomic temp file then rename like store.Save


## Dependencies
- req1


## Definition of done
- Writer implemented


## Non-functional requirements
- Atomic write


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Runner writes a report after every run whatever the outcome
nodes.body:
Context: Runner.Run returns from several branches (agent failure, publish failure, awaiting approval, completed). Desired behavior: an optional Reporter set via SetReporter is called once after any run that acquired the lock, with the final execution and timestamps. Runs refused by lock.ErrLocked write nothing. Expected result: every executed run leaves a report. Why: reports must exist whatever the outcome.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a failing agent, When Run returns, Then a report with status FAILED and the error text is written
- Given a successful run with and without AutoPublish, When Run returns, Then reports with COMPLETED and AWAITING_APPROVAL are written
- Given the lock is held, When Run is called, Then no report is written


## Scope
- In scope: backend/worker/internal/runner/runner.go
- Out of scope: Git commits
- Preserve: New signature
- Preserve: Run return values and persisted store records


## Technical constraints
- Reporter is an interface so tests fake it


## Dependencies
- req2


## Definition of done
- Runner wired to Reporter


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.description: Create the report package with Report struct and Writer.Write that validates the id, then writes JSON atomically.
acceptance_criteria: Write validates id via store.ValidateID
Write produces <dir>/<id>.json atomically

steps.action: Create package report with struct Report with json tags: ExecutionID execution_id string, RoundID round_id string, Status store.Status status, Attempts attempts int, Error error string, StartedAt started_at time.Time, FinishedAt finished_at time.Time, DurationMS duration_ms int64

Add Writer{dir string}, New(dir) *Writer, and Write(r Report) error: call store.ValidateID(r.ExecutionID) first and return its error; os.MkdirAll(dir,0o755); json.MarshalIndent; os.CreateTemp(dir, ".tmp-*"); write, close, os.Rename to filepath.Join(dir, id+".json"); remove temp on failure
steps.expected: Valid report yields <dir>/<id>.json; invalid id returns before touching disk
